title: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys
body:
Deal: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys

[jv] That is worth $24 … So basically 20% back…
[Hereforthegoods] I got 3200 for $80. Very mid, will be skipping this one
[jv] That is worth $16 … So basically 20% back…
[Hereforthegoods] the rate this time appears to be 40 points per dollar, and the dollar value changes per account. I just can't be bothered doing an $80 shop because I live by myself.
Edit: though it's stackable with that AMP bank deal so 🤔
[INFIDEL] Last week Offer was 5400 for $80.
And 3200 for $60 on same account.
Stacked that with 4 week of $60 spend for 10k pts for total of 18600pt ($93) on just over $260 spend
Am all stocked up now until next 4 week offer.
[jv] "Collect 6,000 bonus points when you spend $150 in one transaction in-store or online at Coles"
😲
[jv] That is worth $30 … So basically 20% back…
[surfingedge] In the past 2 weeks I got 4 of these offers. Adding them all up comes to 16k points for $360 spend. I used the points from each offer to part pay for the next spend.
[masterqur] got a 1800 points for $30 a few days ago
[CW66WC] The previous Coles spend Flybuys offer ending today equated to 30% back.
[ATTS] Is that the best now?
I got that too
Usually i get 2000 pts for $30 spend
[StephenCurry] After doing it and I could see the points in my account the next day, but the offer still shows activated and not disappearing. But I assume it's a one time thing? Or that you could complete it multiple times during the period?
[Targaryen] It’s a one time thing only.
Resets end of promo week as opposed to immediately after shopping. 🛒
[ATangk] 2000 for $60. It’s not great; will skip after getting the 25% TCB.
[Chinese Angel] If this is about 20% n i received several 20% off or $3 off $10 spent so it's very tempting but my offer is 2,800 points for $70 spend. My last 4 week offer was $50…so very reluctant to achieve it as i know my next 4 weeks offer will increased to $70 or even $80
[Grey 13] 2800 pts for $70 spent.
I think I'll pass.
And yes @jv it's 20% "back" :)
[ely] 7200 for $180; made the mistake of doing 10k for 4x$150 shops, I could have sworn it was 20k, they're going to be giving me crap deals for months now. Might burn down that flybuys account and start a new one.
[cmoddoo] Open a new one and leave the old one unused for a while until the amount drops
[Craicdealer] 4,400 for $110 for me. Very similar offers the past 3- 4 weeks varying slightly in spend and points. They can't use "Down Down Prices are Down" anymore so tempting us through the door this way?
[SeaveyA1] I activated last week's and did my shop, did not even get any bonus points on any accounts. Very frustrating
[Onemoredeal] It’s a trap! Trying to scam me off the next $50 x 4 and increase the spend haha
[BigBucko] Getting heaps of these lately…Deal is don't spend more than the offer! Same as the $50x4. Otherwise they keep raising the goal. I literally turn offers down just to keep it a rate where its value and works for me, not them.
[suchcha] They usually send these offers back to back and the trick is to do the shopping on Tuesdays or Fridays when the offers overlap. So you can double dip and get 40% back as points.
